notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Adeline trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Mondrak attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Adeline trigger, creating 2^(the number of Mondraks you control) 1/1 Human creature tokens tapped and attacking each opponent.
